book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: And Passepartout?
He woke in the opium den, his head aching.
And remembered: the steamer!
And ran to the harbour, reeling.
And the Carnatic was about to sail.

sentences.ar: ونط عليها، ووقع على السطح، ونام مرة تانية.
sentences.en: And he leapt onto her, fell on the deck, and slept again.
And woke a day later, in mid-ocean.
And looked for Fogg.
Not there.
And Aouda.
Not there.
And he understood.

sentences.ar: فيكس خدره، وسيده ما لحق الباخرة.
sentences.en: Fix had drugged him, and his master had missed the steamer.

sentences.ar: وهو راكب لحاله، بلا مصاري، بلا شي.
sentences.en: And he was sailing alone, without money, without anything.
And he sat on deck, and beat his head with his hands.
And said: because of me.
Because of me.

sentences.ar: وفكر بفيكس، وقال: إذا لقيته، بخنقه.
sentences.en: And thought of Fix, and said: if I find him, I strangle him.

sentences.ar: وبعد ستة أيام، وصلت الكارناتيك يوكوهاما.
sentences.en: And after six days, the Carnatic reached Yokohama.

sentences.ar: ونزل باسبارتو، بتيابه المقطعة، وبطنه فاضي.
sentences.en: And Passepartout got off, in his torn clothes, his belly empty.
And walked through the city.

sentences.ar: بيوت من خشب وورق، وناس بتياب حرير، وأشجار كرز.
sentences.en: Houses of wood and paper, people in silk, cherry trees.
And the smell of food from everywhere.
And he was hungry.
And sold his coat to a dealer, for a few coins.
And ate rice and fish.
And said: tomorrow?
And sat thinking.
I must reach America.
And my master will pass through here.
Surely.

sentences.ar: بس بلا مصاري، ما في باخرة.
sentences.en: But without money, there is no steamer.
And then he saw a sign.
A troupe of Japanese acrobats, travelling to America.
And Passepartout smiled.
And said: I was an acrobat.
